semantics.authorization: original phone-signin flow and canonical number binding; current native recipient and issuance policy
semantics.idempotency_transport: exactly one Idempotency-Key header -> required request.IdempotencyKey
semantics.event_semantics: Existing-account phone SMS-code issuance only. Authenticate original target-bound pre-auth custody before discovery or code work; preserve tenant, canonical number profile, purpose, remember policy and earliest expiry. Acceptance includes suppression and proves neither recipient existence nor delivery. Actual OTP/delivery owners retain counted admission, encrypted generation, durable idempotency and unknown-outcome recovery. No signup, enrollment, reset, replacement, code comparison or session issuance.

semantics.access: original pre-auth custody plus current historical disclosure policy
semantics.authorization: original phone-signin possession and current historical disclosure policy; no executable-flow requirement
semantics.event_semantics: Code-free observation of the original phone consuming correlation, including consumed or expired original flows. Current disclosure permission and original possession remain mandatory. No code comparison, attempt debit, execution retry, SMS resend, session/CSRF delivery or renewed freshness. Historical session identity is not current authentication; unknown remains unknown. Apply signin IP admission without executable-source discovery or another identifier debit.

definition.name: SigninSendRequest
definition.representation: Opaque constructor-only handle; fields describe the explicit SigninSendRequestSpec projection, never automatic JSON.

fields.name: TenantID
fields.semantics: Trusted tenant, exactly matching original target-bound pre-auth custody.

fields.name: Number
fields.semantics: Owner-canonical number under the exact selected stored profile; not phone possession or account eligibility.

fields.name: Caller
fields.semantics: Trusted identity.phone.signin initiating actor/policy; never browser-selected account authority.

fields.name: Flow
fields.semantics: Original public pre-auth ID and actual cookie possession. Native ownership compares action, number commitment, remember and expiry.

fields.name: Network
fields.semantics: Bounded network attribution from trusted ingress.

fields.name: Device
fields.semantics: Bounded original signed-device attribution from trusted ingress.

fields.name: IdempotencyKey
fields.semantics: Original issuance retry key; never a code, challenge or user selector.

fields.name: CommandID
fields.semantics: Original server-derived Send correlation when available; not delivery or authentication evidence.

fields.name: Outcome
fields.semantics: Observed issuance or suppression durability. Unknown does not imply rollback.

fields.name: RetryAfter
fields.semantics: Bounded original pending receipt delay, not permission to generate replacement custody.

variants.semantics: Malformed canonical request or unsupported initiating profile; no supplied number or cookie in diagnostics.
Original possession, number/action binding or current policy denies without recipient disclosure.
Retain original issuance key/custody; never infer rollback or regenerate code.
Bounded native storage, admission, cancellation or delivery-preparation failure; no credentials disclosed.

fields.name: TenantID
fields.semantics: Exact original tenant, agreeing with retained correlation and trusted host.

fields.name: UserID
fields.semantics: Must be empty for this anonymous public initiating profile; native custody selects the original account.

fields.name: Caller
fields.semantics: Trusted identity.phone.signin.recover actor; native current historical disclosure policy remains mandatory.

fields.name: Flow
fields.semantics: Original public flow ID and cookie possession, not renewed executable admission.

fields.name: Recovery
fields.semantics: Unchanged original Send/attempt/fingerprint/version/scope correlation, without a submitted code.

fields.name: SessionID
fields.semantics: Historical original session identity only when committed and authorized for disclosure; never current authentication.

fields.name: Issuance
fields.semantics: Original command, outcome and replayed history; token/cookie credentials absent and live session may be zero.

fields.name: Recovery
fields.semantics: Unchanged original code-free correlation; no authority to resubmit execution.

variants.semantics: Malformed or mismatched original recovery correlation.
Original possession or current historical disclosure policy denies; no destination or credential is returned.
Original durability unresolved; preserve correlation and never compare the code again.
Bounded native storage/custody/cancellation failure, never fabricated rollback or credential delivery.
